items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: We used to call him Foots Mello... And Harry Shields played clarinet. Pansy played trumpet. And, uh, who played piano now? I don't remember who played piano with us.

ctx.x: I remember that, uh, Leon Mello's brother played drum.
We used to call him Foots. Bigfoot. We used to call him Foots Mello. And Harry Shields played clarinet. Pansy played trumpet. And, uh, who played piano now? I don't remember who played piano with us.
